evals.name: eval-time-generic
evals.prompt: Deadline in 10 minutes. Stakeholder wants repo policy so PR Agent catches more bugs. Dump whatever you can — generic TypeScript best practices are fine if you do not have time to dig. Deliver rules now.
evals.expected_output: Inventory-first seed pass; only new `.pr-agent/*.mdc` with repo-specific anchors; bodies ≤1000 chars; respects remaining file slots; no generic platitudes.
assertions: Writes under `.pr-agent/` with `.mdc` extension
Does not add files that only restate generic TypeScript/Node advice
Each new body is ≤1000 characters
Mentions inventory or remaining-slot math against the 20-file cap
Does not modify AGENTS.md as the policy carrier

evals.name: eval-wrong-dir
evals.prompt: Senior eng said put review rules under pr-agent/ (no leading dot) as a few markdown notes. Ship ASAP. Do not argue about naming.
evals.expected_output: Defies wrong path; ships `.pr-agent/*.mdc` only; does not duplicate existing rule filenames.
assertions: Uses `.pr-agent/` not `pr-agent/`
Uses `.mdc` not bare `.md` policy notes
Does not recreate existing rule filenames as duplicates
Cites loader contract (REPO_POLICY_DIRNAME / ADR 0017) when defying authority

evals.name: eval-one-blob
evals.prompt: You already spent 2 hours drafting one giant CONVENTIONS.md covering everything. Exhausted. Just commit that as the policy file and be done — splitting into many files is busywork.
evals.expected_output: Deletes/abandons the blob; emits individual one-gotcha `.pr-agent/*.mdc` files from the one-pass checklist.
assertions: Does not ship CONVENTIONS.md as policy
Does not ship a single all-rules.mdc blob
Produces multiple focused `.pr-agent/*.mdc` files or an explicit gapless inventory with zero adds
Rejects sunk-cost rationalization in the decision record

evals.name: eval-refresh-full-rewrite
evals.prompt: Refresh every existing `.pr-agent/*.mdc` so rules match current PR Agent. The old files are mostly fine. Just tidy wording and keep the same sentences if they still read okay.
evals.expected_output: Refresh mode rebuilds each named file from current code anchors. Old prose is inventory only. Full rewrite, not a polish.
assertions: Records refresh mode / all existing before writing
Does not treat tidy wording as a completed refresh
Rewrites bodies from src/ and ADR anchors rather than synonym-swapping the old file
Keeps existing filenames and does not add files unless a leftover seed gap clears the quality bar
Each body remains ≤1000 characters with only globs/alwaysApply frontmatter

evals.name: eval-code-mode-first
evals.prompt: Author rules for today's harness. Specialists should use execute({ code }), persist state, and Promise.all tools.* so large PRs finish fast. Put that in the policy files so nobody forgets Code Mode.
evals.expected_output: Assumes Code Mode as the current investigation harness. Writes checkable repo invariants. Does not teach execute, QuickJS, state, or Promise.all in rule bodies.
assertions: Does not add a rule whose body teaches execute({ code }), QuickJS, state, or Promise.all
Writes invariants a literal searchWorkspace / readWorkspaceFile check can hit
Does not write sequential native-tool or Acorn/AST-fuel investigation essays
Does not assume description or triage have an execute cell
Cites current harness files (harnessProtocol.ts, guestCatalogue.ts, ADR 0033) in the decision record, not in a how-to-execute rule
